heroHeading: Whatever brought you here tonight, you don’t have to carry it alone.
heroSubtext: Counseling for betrayal trauma, addiction recovery, relationships, anxiety, and depression — in person in West Chester, Ohio, or by telehealth anywhere in the state.
personalWelcome: [DRAFT — Matthew to rewrite in his own words] I'm Matthew. Reaching out is hard — I want you to know that whatever you bring, you'll be met with acceptance, not judgment.
